data.long_meaning: From the Persian word 'bulandan' meaning 'exalted' or 'noble'. This name carries a sense of honor and dignity, reflecting a person's high moral character and strong will. The name Buland carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Buland usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: بلند
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب بلند یا اونچا ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: بلند نام عربی زبان کے جڑ ب-ل-ن سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند یا اونچا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اپنے اخلاق اور اعمال میں بلند مرتبہ رکھتا ہے۔

historical_references.reference: Buland Ishaan, a magnificent edifice located in Agra, India, was built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan between 1625 and 1633 AD to commemorate his defeat of the Deccan Sultanate and the establishment of his imperial power in the Deccan region.
historical_references.context: Mughal Empire, India, Defeat of Deccan Sultanate
